text: The accepted icon page maps 12/16/20/24 pixel assets to xs/sm/md/lg directories and variable suffixes, with registration in the size-organized area of jar.inc.mn. Its upload-sm example matches an actual CSS URL and registered resource. The document prefers existing icon variables, including img content, while retaining legacy, illustration and fixed-brand-color exceptions. Use that scoped accepted guidance without treating every old asset as an error or changing deliberate project instructions. No docs build, visual or accessibility check was run.
title: Accepted icon documentation links size folders, resource registration and CSS variables
